what_is_plotted: rows with role 'primary' or 'floor' from diagnostic_capacity_validation.json; 'context' rows are excluded (they duplicate or under-specify a plotted point)

encoding.colour: lever family (4 validated categorical slots; the classical comparator is neutral ink + hollow face, not a 5th hue)
encoding.shape: circle = bound over the trained population; square = bound over band centres (doc 47 SS18.1)
encoding.x_offset: points sharing an x are given a deterministic horizontal offset of +/- 0.0042 so they do not overlap; `x_bound` is the true value, `x_plotted` is where the mark was drawn

palette.validator: node scripts/validate_palette.js "#2a78d6,#eb6834,#1baf7a,#4a3aa7" --mode light --pairs all -> PASS (CVD 9.2, normal-vision 16.3); aqua contrast WARN 2.74, relief = direct labels + table view

labelled_points: exp68 F2  width register 0.959 vs bound 1.000
exp67 R8  M-ary readout 0.739 vs bound 1.000
